functions.name: BM25Okapi.__init__
outputs: attrs corpus_size:int, avgdl:float, doc_len:list[int], doc_freqs:list[dict term->count] (first-occurrence order), idf:dict (first-seen order), average_idf:float
sideEffects: with a tokenizer, the original tokenizes using a multiprocessing pool of cpu_count() workers
functions.behavior: avgdl = total_tokens / n_docs (true division). For each term in first-seen order: idf = ln(N - df + 0.5) - ln(df + 0.5); sum them left to right starting at 0; average_idf = sum / vocab_size; every term with idf < 0 gets epsilon * average_idf.

functions.name: get_scores
inputs: query: list of tokens (repeats count again)
functions.behavior: score starts at +0.0 for every doc; for each query token q in order, add contrib(q, d) to every doc d, where idf(q) = 0 if q is missing or idf 0, tf = count of q in d (0 if absent), dl = doc length. norm = (1 - b) + (b * dl) / avgdl. Okapi: idf * ((tf * (k1 + 1)) / (tf + k1 * norm)). L: ctd = tf / norm; ((idf * (k1 + 1)) * (ctd + delta)) / ((k1 + ctd) + delta). Plus: idf * (delta + (tf * (k1 + 1)) / (k1 * norm + tf)). IEEE-754 double, this exact operation order, no fused multiply-add. Note: docs without the term still receive contrib with tf = 0 (nonzero for L/Plus; NaN when a denominator is 0).

functions.name: get_batch_scores
outputs: list[float], same values as get_scores at those ids

functions.name: get_top_n
outputs: list of the n documents with the highest scores, descending
functions.behavior: original order is reverse of numpy argsort (default kind); tie order is not specified by the original

unknowns.question: Tie order of get_top_n
probes: original reverses numpy argsort (introsort / SIMD sort, platform dependent), so equal scores have no stable order
unknowns.settle: Not settleable: the original is nondeterministic across numpy builds. New build defines it: score descending, then lower doc id. Vectors for get_top_n use tie-free inputs only.

unknowns.question: Non-str tokens
unknowns.settle: Decide whether ints/tuples matter to users; new build raises TypeError for non-str corpus tokens and treats non-str query tokens as missing.

unknowns.question: Mutating .idf / .doc_freqs after construction
probes: original reads self.idf on every query
unknowns.settle: New build scores from its native index; edits to the returned dicts do not change scores. Document; revisit if a user depends on it.

unknowns.question: libm ln() equality across platforms
probes: both sides call the platform log(); bit-equal on Linux x86_64 glibc
unknowns.settle: Run replay + fuzz on macOS and Windows wheels before claiming bit-equality there.

unknowns.question: Which rank_bm25 is 'the' reference: PyPI 0.2.2 or git main?
probes: diffed the PyPI 0.2.2 wheel against git 47aa3dd: BM25L has an extra tf factor in 0.2.2; BM25Plus idf is ln((N+1)/df) in 0.2.2 vs ln(N+1) - ln(df) in git; BM25Okapi is identical
unknowns.settle: Default to what pip installs (0.2.2); offer compat='47aa3dd' for git-main users.
